name: Marshmallow Rice Squares II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup marshmallows (either regular white, cream soda flavour, or bubblegum flavour)

steps: Melt marshmallows in the microwave in 30 second intervals until it melts into a creamy mixture.
Remove marshmallow fluff from microwave, pour in the milk, and mix for 1½ minutes.
Add the powdered sugar and mix for 2 more minutes.
Add the puffed cereal, and mix for 1 more minute.
Put back in microwave and heat for 13 seconds.
Remove from the microwave and mix a final time.
Press into a greased dish or pan. Let set, then cut into pieces.
